node.statement: For Z in S_P and X,Y in S_{P,Q}, the defining Ha identity and the bounds of 1.2.1.1 give 2*abs(<Y,h(Z)X>)*||u_Q|| <= ||(Y^dagger dot Z) dot X||+||Y^dagger dot (Z dot X)|| <= 2*K_dot^2*||Y||||Z||||X||. Hence abs(<Y,h(Z)X>) <= K_1*q(Y)*||Z||*q(X), where K_1=K_dot^2*c_q^2/c_u. Hilbert-space duality in the q norm yields q(h(Z)X)<=K_1||Z||q(X), so ||h(Z)||<=K_1||Z||. The same defining identity is linear in Z and uniqueness against all Y gives linearity of h.
